question: Independent single-video floor plan experiment: rooms, doorways, wall contents and camera route; distinguish observed from inferred.

requests.purpose: Chronological overview: find room transitions, wall anchors and camera turns
Full chronological pass at one-second intervals to trace walls and room adjacency
Resolve bathroom side, doorway reversal and bedroom across corridor; do not count reflected door as another room
Revisit final turn: dining-kitchen opening, peninsula, appliance wall and utility alcove

claims.text: Route seen: shelving-lined study, wide opening to sitting room, exit into long landing/hall, bathroom doorway on travel-left, bedroom doorway on travel-right, then dining room and adjoining kitchen. Bathroom includes sink and mirror, glass shower, toilet and window; bedroom is only viewed from threshold.
claims.limitation: Sampled video; dimensions and hidden wall extents are not measured.

claims.text: Kitchen is on the right when entering dining from the hall: final turn places dining bay windows left and kitchen right; reverse view shows kitchen in fireplace mirror. Kitchen has range/hood cabinet wall, refrigerator to range-right, sink to range-left, peninsula toward dining and utility/laundry area to kitchen-left when facing range.
claims.limitation: Corrects initial left-side hypothesis. Mirror is a reflected view, not another room. Utility enclosure extent remains uncertain.

claims.text: Bookshelf and lamp glimpsed through the travel-right hall doorway around 24 seconds likely belong to the starting study, creating a second study access and a loop with the sitting room. A long narrow plan with side rooms and a locally bent hall fits the camera route.
claims.limitation: Second study doorway was not traversed; similar furniture could belong to a different room. Room footprints and overall alignment are schematic.

claims.text: Unknown: actual dimensions, compass direction, hidden room walls, destinations behind closed doors, downstairs layout and whether the second bookshelf doorway is the same study. The clip cannot establish the complete property floor plan.
